title: bug: the board's /ws UPDATE_TASK refuses BACKLOG to REVIEW, which set_task_status and MCP_SERVER.md allow, so a sweep-parked review dragged from Backlog to Review on the VS Code board gets an ERROR frame and stays in BACKLOG (the /ws copy of VALID_TRANSITIONS drifted in 53271caf)
description:
Filed by defect hunt 11-03 #3 (task-859eff80). This is contract drift between the two copies of the status-transition table.

PROBLEM
- packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:495-508 is the /ws UPDATE_TASK board-move handler. Its comment says "Keep in sync with VALID_TRANSITIONS in src/tools/setTaskStatus.ts", but its table has `BACKLOG: ['PLANNING', 'WORKING', 'ARCHIVED']`.
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/setTaskStatus.ts:46 has `BACKLOG: ['PLANNING', 'WORKING', 'REVIEW', 'ARCHIVED']`. Its comment at :37-39 explains why: "BACKLOG → REVIEW is the un-park path: the blocked-timeout sweep parks in-flight tasks (including REVIEW) in BACKLOG, and a human restoring a parked review must be able to send it straight back to the QA queue".
- Every other row of the two tables is identical.
- History: 53271caf (2026-07-23) added REVIEW to setTaskStatus.ts only. The /ws copy has not changed since 0aab4d36. This is drift, not a choice.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md:1637-1639 says `BACKLOG → PLANNING/WORKING/REVIEW` are all legal, and :1670 says "The plugin `/ws` board-move handler enforces the same rules".
- Who hits it:
  - VS Code: the board drag (moe-vscode/media/board.js:1068-1111, onDrop → moveMessage) sends UPDATE_TASK {status:'REVIEW'} for a Backlog card dropped on Review.
  - JetBrains: the board has no direct BACKLOG→REVIEW path (BoardMoves.kt mirrors the /ws table), so a human there must use MCP.
  - No other /ws route restores a parked review: REOPEN_TASK goes to PLANNING.

EVIDENCE
- Repro on HEAD ef5c7101. A hunt subagent wrote it in /tmp/hunt-859e-B; I re-ran it myself in /tmp/hunt-859e-snap (git archive with Linux node_modules). Persisted copies: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-859e/B/zzHuntBWsBacklogReview.test.ts and zzHuntBWsBacklogReview.output.txt.
- Command: `cd packages/moe-daemon && LOG_LEVEL=fatal npx vitest run src/server/zzHuntBWsBacklogReview.test.ts`. Result: 1 failed.
  - `MCP set_task_status BACKLOG->REVIEW => {"success":true,"taskId":"task-mcp","status":"REVIEW",...}`
  - `/ws UPDATE_TASK BACKLOG->REVIEW => [{"type":"ERROR","message":"Cannot move task from BACKLOG to REVIEW. Allowed: PLANNING, WORKING, ARCHIVED"}] stored status = BACKLOG`
  - `AssertionError: expected 'BACKLOG' to be 'REVIEW'`

FIX DIRECTION
- Make the two tables one:
  - export VALID_TRANSITIONS from tools/setTaskStatus.ts (or move it to a small shared module if the import would cycle);
  - use it in the /ws handler in place of the inline copy, keeping the "Allowed: …" error text format;
  - keep the existing gates, including the upward-move execution-profile check.
- Check that the /ws path applies set_task_status's side effects for a move into REVIEW where they matter, e.g. the needsHumanReview clear at setTaskStatus.ts:217-226. The /ws handler clears it only on reopening moves, through buildReopenClearingUpdates. If the new move needs it, mirror it; otherwise say why in the plan.
- No MCP or /ws message shape changes, and no doc change: the code catches up with MCP_SERVER.md.

FILES: packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts and packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/setTaskStatus.ts, plus one NEW test file under packages/moe-daemon/src/server/ (shape: the repro above, which drives a real WebSocketServer UPDATE_TASK frame). None is held by an open row (lanes.js at 16:26Z).
definitionOfDone: A /ws UPDATE_TASK that moves a BACKLOG task to REVIEW succeeds: the stored status is REVIEW and the move is broadcast. An illegal move such as BACKLOG to DONE is still refused with the same 'Cannot move task from X to Y. Allowed: …' ERROR text.

The /ws handler and set_task_status read one shared transition table, so no inline copy remains in WebSocketServer.ts. A NEW test asserts that every (from, to) pair the shared table allows or refuses gets the same verdict from /ws UPDATE_TASK as from moe.set_task_status. Restoring today's inline /ws table fails it.
The existing WebSocketServer and setTaskStatus tests pass unchanged.

Verification, in a snapshot outside the shared checkout: `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/server/<new test file> src/server/WebSocketServer.test.ts src/tools/setTaskStatus.test.ts && npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0.

implementationPlan.description:
Write the NEW test packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.transitions.test.ts with the Write tool. Copy its content from the dry-run-verified reference /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-6a81/WebSocketServer.transitions.test.ts (sha256 086f48de…, 174 lines), and change it only if it fails for you.

It drives a real MoeWebSocketServer on 127.0.0.1:0 over a temp .moe with a TURBO project and no columnLimits. Before state.load() it writes 2 task files per (from, to) pair, `ws-<from>-<to>` and `mcp-<from>-<to>`, for all 56 pairs with from ≠ to over Object.keys(VALID_TRANSITIONS). Each BLOCKED fixture carries blockedFromStatus 'WORKING'. The fixture also writes task-backlog, task-backlog-2, task-parked-backlog (BACKLOG, needsHumanReview true) and task-parked-blocked (BLOCKED from REVIEW, needsHumanReview true).

A connect() helper buffers frames, so none is lost between awaits. It waits for STATE_SNAPSHOT, and its move(taskId, status) sends UPDATE_TASK and resolves on that task's TASK_UPDATED or an ERROR.

Tests:
1. Parity (DoD 2): for each pair, call setTaskStatusTool(state).handler and classify the result as ok / table-refused (the message contains `<from> -> <to>. Allowed transitions from <from>:`) / other. Then call /ws move and classify it as ok / table-refused (the message starts with `Cannot move task from <from> to <to>. Allowed:`) / other.
   - Expected: ok where the table allows, table-refused where it refuses.
   - Each refused /ws pair must match the EXACT text built from VALID_TRANSITIONS[from].join(', ').
   - Annotated exception: /ws AWAITING_APPROVAL->WORKING is plan approval (it needs CLIENT_HELLO plus the plan-revision token), so it only has to avoid the table refusal.
   - Collect the mismatch strings and finish with expect(mismatches).toEqual([]), so a failure names every bad pair.
2. DoD 1: wire state.setEmitter(e => wss.broadcast(e)) and open two clients, an actor and an observer.
   - The actor's BACKLOG→REVIEW gets TASK_UPDATED {id, status:'REVIEW'}, and the stored status is REVIEW.
   - The observer receives the broadcast TASK_UPDATED for that task.
   - BACKLOG→DONE gets an ERROR toMatchObject message 'Cannot move task from BACKLOG to DONE. Allowed: PLANNING, WORKING, REVIEW, ARCHIVED' (the frame also carries operation and context, so use toMatchObject, not toEqual), and the stored status stays BACKLOG.
3. it.each over task-parked-backlog and task-parked-blocked: a /ws move into REVIEW succeeds and stored needsHumanReview === false.

afterEach closes the sockets, the server and http, awaits state.flushActivityLog(), then rmSync's the temp dir.

Verification: run once, fresh, in a /tmp snapshot. Never run npm or vitest in /mnt/d/projexts/moes or in your worktree (global rail). From your task checkout:
  R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); S=$(mktemp -d /tmp/moe-6a81-XXXXXX); P=$S/packages/moe-daemon; mkdir -p "$P"
  tar -C "$R/packages/moe-daemon" --exclude=node_modules --exclude=dist -cf - . | tar -xf - -C "$P"
  cmp "$P/package-lock.json" /tmp/hunt-859e-snap/packages/moe-daemon/package-lock.json && cp -al /tmp/hunt-859e-snap/packages/moe-daemon/node_modules "$P/node_modules" && rm -rf "$P/node_modules/.vite"
That Linux node_modules matched the daemon lock at 27fc6aed. If the cmp fails or the dir is gone, run `(cd "$P" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund)` instead (mem:gotcha-gate-snapshot-psparse-and-proxy-rolldown).

Then, from "$S", run the exact checkRef:
  cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/server/WebSocketServer.transitions.test.ts src/server/WebSocketServer.test.ts src/tools/setTaskStatus.test.ts && npx tsc --noEmit
It must exit 0. My dry run gave 'Test Files 3 passed (3)', 'Tests 150 passed (150)' (4 new + 146 existing) and a silent tsc. The 19 files under src/server plus setTaskStatus, releaseTask and taskExecutionPolicy also passed (766).

Mutation proof for DoD 2, in the SNAPSHOT only:
- `B=$(git -C "$R" merge-base HEAD "${MOE_LAND_TARGET:-HEAD}")`, then `git -C "$R" show "$B:packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts" > "$P/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts"`.
- Check that the result still contains `const VALID_TRANSITIONS: Record<string, string[]>`. If it does not, B is not the pre-task base: stop and fix B.
- Run `npx vitest run src/server/WebSocketServer.transitions.test.ts` from $P. My dry run: 4 failed. The parity list names `BACKLOG -> REVIEW: table allows, set_task_status ok, /ws table-refused (Cannot move task from BACKLOG to REVIEW. Allowed: PLANNING, WORKING, ARCHIVED)`, plus the BACKLOG -> AWAITING_APPROVAL/BLOCKED/DONE text mismatches.
- Quote those lines in complete_task. Then copy your checkout's WebSocketServer.ts back into $P before you cite the green run.

Submit the green checkRef command, its exit code and the output tail as the verification. Say it ran in a /tmp snapshot of your working tree, with matching sha256sum of the 3 files. Delete only your own mktemp dir, and kill only PIDs your own session started (rail).

Adversarial self-review: one pass over your own diff (`git diff $(git merge-base HEAD "${MOE_LAND_TARGET:-HEAD}") -- packages/moe-daemon` plus anything uncommitted). Check each item and fix what fails:
(1) `grep -n "VALID_TRANSITIONS\|Record<string, string\[\]>" packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts` shows only the import and its uses. No inline table remains (DoD 2).
(2) `grep -n WebSocketServer packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/setTaskStatus.ts` is empty, so there is no cycle.
(3) The refusal and BLOCKED texts are byte-identical to before. The parity test pins every refused pair.
(4) The shared table is typed Readonly<… readonly …[]>, so no importer can mutate it.
(5) The needsHumanReview clear fires only for a move INTO REVIEW, inside withMutex, and overrides a client-sent true.
(6) The approval and reopen routes are unchanged. A same-status UPDATE_TASK still skips the transition block.
(7) Two concurrent UPDATE_TASK frames for one task are still serialized by withMutex.
(8) WebSocketServer.test.ts and setTaskStatus.test.ts are byte-unchanged (DoD 3).
(9) The new test has no .only, no fixed sleeps, and closes every socket and server.
(10) Out of scope, so do not edit it: moe-jetbrains BoardMoves.kt still mirrors the old /ws table, so the JetBrains board still lacks a direct BACKLOG→REVIEW drag. Name it in your complete_task summary as a follow-up for the governor.
If you change anything, re-run step 3's checkRef and submit THAT output.

comments.content:
Governor note for the planner: treat this as a narrow row, whatever get_context says.
- epic-be924fb8 (Stability & Hardening) is a long-running bucket epic with no finalTaskId, so isEpicFinal falls back to the highest order. This row reads isEpicFinal:true only because it is the newest row, not because it integrates the epic (architect-74d9e1c7 flagged this in msg-baab00d0).
- Plan the verification for this row's own surface: the new and changed vitest files for WebSocketServer.ts and setTaskStatus.ts, plus the existing tests for both. No full-suite, Gradle or launcher gate.
- In worktree mode the project qualityGate already runs on every landing.
- Placement: a docs-only row filed at 16:30Z edits MCP_SERVER.md's set_task_status transition paragraph. This row needs no MCP_SERVER.md edit, since :1637-1639 and :1670 already describe BACKLOG to REVIEW correctly.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: The board's /ws UPDATE_TASK judges status moves by the same exported VALID_TRANSITIONS table as moe.set_task_status. A BACKLOG task can then be dragged to REVIEW (the un-park path that MCP_SERVER.md documents), while illegal moves keep the same 'Cannot move task from X to Y. Allowed: …' ERROR text. A /ws move into REVIEW also clears needsHumanReview, as set_task_status does, so the restored row re-enters the QA queue.
acceptanceCriteria: A /ws UPDATE_TASK moving a BACKLOG task to REVIEW stores REVIEW, replies TASK_UPDATED, and is broadcast to the other /ws clients.
A /ws BACKLOG to DONE is refused with exactly 'Cannot move task from BACKLOG to DONE. Allowed: PLANNING, WORKING, REVIEW, ARCHIVED', and the stored status stays BACKLOG.
No inline transition table remains in WebSocketServer.ts. It imports VALID_TRANSITIONS from tools/setTaskStatus.ts.

Across all 56 (from, to) pairs, /ws and set_task_status give the table's verdict. Refused /ws pairs carry the exact table text, and AWAITING_APPROVAL->WORKING on /ws only has to avoid the table refusal. Restoring today's inline /ws table fails this.
A /ws move into REVIEW of a row with needsHumanReview true leaves needsHumanReview false. This covers both BACKLOG→REVIEW and BLOCKED→REVIEW.
The existing WebSocketServer.test.ts and setTaskStatus.test.ts pass unchanged.
invariants: The refusal message format `Cannot move task from X to Y. Allowed: a, b` is unchanged.
The BLOCKED effectiveFrom gate, the WIP limits, the plan-approval route and the reopen route on /ws behave as before.
Every validation and write stays inside withMutex, and a refused move writes nothing.
No MCP or /ws message shape changes, and docs are untouched.
compatibility: Existing .moe task files need no migration.
Board clients (VS Code, JetBrains) send the same frames and get the same reply shapes; only BACKLOG→REVIEW starts succeeding.
approvedScope: setTaskStatus.ts: export VALID_TRANSITIONS, readonly-typed and with unchanged content
WebSocketServer.ts UPDATE_TASK handler: import the shared table, drop the inline copy, cast newStatus as TaskStatus, and clear needsHumanReview on a move into REVIEW
New src/server/WebSocketServer.transitions.test.ts: the parity, e2e-broadcast and needsHumanReview cases
reuse: Reuses set_task_status's own VALID_TRANSITIONS rather than a new module.
The test's fixture follows the hunt repro and WebSocketServer.test.ts: a real http server, MoeWebSocketServer and McpAdapter over a temp .moe.
sourceAssumptions: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/setTaskStatus.ts:46 BACKLOG row is ['PLANNING','WORKING','REVIEW','ARCHIVED']. :217-226 clears needsHumanReview on any move.

packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:495-508 holds the inline table with BACKLOG ['PLANNING','WORKING','ARCHIVED']. :510-512 throws the refusal text. :592 is the approval route and :620 the reopen route.
packages/moe-daemon/src/state/taskStore.ts updateTask (~:427) holds the shared status gates, including assertProgressionReady.
claimNextTask.ts:569/631 and waitForTask.ts:154/184 fence only REVIEW rows with needsHumanReview true.
src/index.ts is the only runtime importer of server/WebSocketServer.js.
checkRefs: cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/server/WebSocketServer.transitions.test.ts src/server/WebSocketServer.test.ts src/tools/setTaskStatus.test.ts && npx tsc --noEmit

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
(1) A new shared module, e.g. util/statusTransitions.ts. Rejected: exporting from setTaskStatus.ts creates no cycle, and the description's FILES list names only these two files plus one test.
(2) Keeping a local alias `const VALID_TRANSITIONS: Record<string,string[]> = SHARED`. Rejected: it reads like a copy, and a cast on newStatus is enough.
(3) Clearing needsHumanReview on EVERY /ws status change, as set_task_status does. Rejected for minimal scope: the claim fence applies only to REVIEW rows, and reopening moves already clear the flag.
(4) A parity test that hard-codes its own expected table. Rejected: DoD 2 says the test judges pairs by the shared table. The e2e case pins BACKLOG→REVIEW, and the exact refusal text pins the BACKLOG row.
My dry run on 27fc6aed in a scratch snapshot:
- green: 150/150 in the gate files and 766/766 across src/server plus the status suites, with tsc clean;
- mutant A (today's inline /ws table) fails all 4 new tests;
- mutant B (fix without the flag clear) fails both needsHumanReview cases.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- set_task_status (setTaskStatus.ts:46) and the /ws UPDATE_TASK handler (WebSocketServer.ts:495-508) carried two copies of the table. 53271caf updated only the first.
- The progression/profile gate (assertProgressionReady) and the assignee clear on status change live in state/taskStore.ts updateTask, which both paths call.
- A /ws ERROR frame for a thrown Error is {type, message, operation:'UPDATE_TASK', context:{taskId}}.
- Broadcasts to /ws clients need state.setEmitter(e => wss.broadcast(e)), which src/index.ts:844 wires and tests must wire themselves.
- needsHumanReview is set only by qa_reject's park (status stays REVIEW, unassigned). It is cleared by set_task_status on any move, by release_task, and by buildReopenClearingUpdates. It is not on UPDATE_TASK_DENYLIST.
- Linux node_modules for the current daemon lock: /tmp/hunt-859e-snap/packages/moe-daemon/node_modules.
planningNotes.risks:
- The parity test creates 112 tasks and makes 56 sequential /ws round trips (about 0.4 s). Do not parallelize the moves: replies are matched by task id or ERROR.
- An ERROR frame carries no task id, so keep the moves sequential.
- If a future gate makes an allowed pair fail on one path, the mismatch list names it. Annotate it explicitly rather than loosening the classifier.
- QA re-run: `git archive <completion sha> packages/moe-daemon | tar -x`, with no overlay, plus the cp -al node_modules, then the checkRef. For the mutant, swap in `git show <sha>^:packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts`.
- Follow-up outside this row: JetBrains BoardMoves.kt mirrors the old /ws table.
